name: jeffrey
description: A coding agent CLI where Jev (TypeSafe System One) decides what to do next and a configurable LLM does the work.

scripts.selftest: mkdir -p "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/jeffrey-selftest" && tsx src/cli.tsx --jev-mock --llm-mock --print --yes -C "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/jeffrey-selftest" "selftest: prove the loop routes, executes and re-scores"
